function anyTrue<T>(x: T extends string ? any : { a: number }) { const wrong: { a: string } = x; }
function anyFalse<T>(x: T extends string ? { a: number } : any) { const wrong: { a: string } = x; }
function anyUnknown<T>(x: T extends string ? any : unknown) { const wrong: { a: string } = x; }
function exact<T>(x: T extends string ? any : { a: number }) {
  x.a = 'wrong';
  x.missing = 1;
  const items = [...x];
  return new x();
}
function unknown<T extends (...args: any[]) => unknown>(value: ReturnType<T>) {
  console.log(value.message);
  for (const item of value) console.log(item);
  return new value();
}
function untypedConstructor<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(value: ReturnType<T>) {
  return new value<string>();
}
function directAnyIteration<T>(inputs: T extends string ? any : any) {
  for (const value of inputs) console.log(value);
  const [first] = inputs;
  return first;
}
function typedBounds<T extends (...args: any[]) => { text: string }>(value: ReturnType<T>) {
  const invalid: number = value;
  value.text = 7;
  value.missing;
  return new value();
}
